note: Kings Canyon National Park campground in Cedar Grove, at the bottom of the glaciated Kings Canyon beside the Cedar Grove Visitor Center, 0.25 miles from the village (store, snack bar, showers, laundry). Paved loops through open ponderosa pine and incense cedar around a central meadow, with the South Fork of the Kings River heard but screened by trees. Most sites are 15-30 ft; check each site's posted length before booking. The nearest dump station is at Princess Campground on CA-180 (summer only). Bear lockers at every site; no cell service; tire chains may be required at any time. The season dates are set yearly. --Claude
